messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Creation of interaction terms for moderation using IndProd - Model does not converge
parts: I try to compute the interaction term of Age (ordinal)
That makes no sense.  You cannot multiply an ordinal variable, unless you treat the arbitrary numeric labels of its categories as values on a continuum.
I see in the output that it does not work correctly as showing by the NA s:

What makes you think that is an error?  Anything multiplied by a missing value is also missing.

c(1, NA, 1) * 3

Also look at the original variables to see if either multiplicand was missing for the same row of data.
